bodyHtml:
Summary notes on how LLMs are used as the reasoning core of autonomous agents.

Surveys agent architectures built around large language models, covering how they plan, use tools, and maintain memory to accomplish multi-step tasks without step-by-step human supervision.

  • Core components: profiling, memory, planning, and action modules
  • Planning strategies include reflection, task decomposition, and self-critique
  • Tool use lets agents call external APIs, search, and code execution environments

title: U-Net — Convolutional Networks for Image Segmentation
description: Summary notes on the UNet encoderdecoder architecture for segmentation. UNet uses a contracting encoder path to capture context paired with a symmetric expandin…
bodyHtml:
Summary notes on the U-Net encoder-decoder architecture for segmentation.

U-Net uses a contracting encoder path to capture context paired with a symmetric expanding decoder path that enables precise localization, with skip connections linking corresponding encoder and decoder layers.

  • Skip connections preserve fine-grained spatial detail lost during downsampling
  • Trains effectively with very few annotated images via heavy data augmentation
  • Widely used beyond biomedical imaging, forming the basis for many segmentation models

bodyHtml:
Summary notes on the statistical foundations underlying modern ML methods.

Covers the bias-variance tradeoff, model selection, and regularization as core statistical tools for building predictive models that generalize well beyond training data.

  • Bias-variance tradeoff explains overfitting and underfitting in model selection
  • Regularization (ridge, lasso) constrains model complexity to improve generalization
  • Cross-validation and bootstrap provide practical estimates of test error

bodyHtml:
Summary notes on the Transformer architecture paper.

Introduces the Transformer, an architecture based entirely on attention mechanisms, removing recurrence and convolutions entirely.

  • Self-attention lets the model weigh all positions in a sequence directly
  • Enabled the current generation of large language models

bodyHtml:
Summary notes on bidirectional transformer pretraining.

BERT pretrains deep bidirectional representations by jointly conditioning on left and right context in all layers, then fine-tunes for downstream tasks.

  • Masked language modeling as the pretraining objective
  • Strong results across many NLP benchmarks with minimal task-specific changes

bodyHtml:
Summary notes on mastering Go with deep neural networks and tree search.

Combines supervised learning from human games with reinforcement learning from self-play, guided by Monte Carlo tree search.

  • First program to beat a professional human Go player
  • Demonstrated RL + search as a powerful combination for hard search spaces
